content: Salut ! Est-ce que tu peux écrire Bonjour sur la couche Top au dessus de mon PCB ?

function.name: execute_pcbnew_script
function.arguments:
{"code":"import pcbnew
board = board
# compute bounding box from footprints (robust)
first = True
xmin = ymin = xmax = ymax = 0
for f in board.GetFootprints():
    try:
        bb = f.GetBoundingBox()
        left = bb.GetX()
        top = bb.GetY()
        right = left + bb.GetWidth()
        bottom = top + bb.GetHeight()
    except Exception:
        p = f.GetPosition()
        left = p.x
        top = p.y
        right = p.x
        bottom = p.y
    if first:
        xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = left, top, right, bottom
        first = False
    else:
        xmin = min(xmin, left)
        ymin = min(ymin, top)
        xmax = max(xmax, right)
        ymax = max(ymax, bottom)
# fallback if no footprints
if first:
    xmin = pcbnew.FromMM(0)
    ymin = pcbnew.FromMM(0)
    xmax = pcbnew.FromMM(50)
    ymax = pcbnew.FromMM(80)
# place text centered horizontally, 3mm above topmost edge
x_center = (xmin + xmax) // 2
y_pos = ymin - pcbnew.FromMM(3)
if y_pos < 0:
    # if that would be negative, place 3mm below top instead
    y_pos = ymin + pcbnew.FromMM(3)
# create PCB_TEXT and add to F.SilkS
text = pcbnew.PCB_TEXT(board)
text.SetText("Bonjour")
try:
    text.SetPosition(pcbnew.wxPoint(int(x_center), int(y_pos)))
except Exception:
    text.SetPosition(pcbnew.VECTOR2I(int(x_center), int(y_pos)))
text.SetLayer(pcbnew.F_SilkS)
# sizing
text.SetTextHeight(pcbnew.FromMM(2.5))
# text width API can vary; set thickness if available
try:
    text.SetTextWidth(pcbnew.FromMM(0.6))
except Exception:
    pass
try:
    text.SetTextThickness(pcbnew.FromMM(0.3))
except Exception:
    pass
# center justification if available
for fn in ("SetHorizontalJustification", "SetHorizJustify", "SetJustify"):
    try:
        getattr(text, fn)(pcbnew.GR_TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
        break
    except Exception:
        pass
board.Add(text)
print("PLACED_TEXT_MM", pcbnew.ToMM(x_center), pcbnew.ToMM(y_pos))
"}

content: Fait — j’ai placé le texte "Bonjour" sur la couche Top (F.SilkS) à 142.45 mm, 36.31 mm. [→ Bonjour in PCB](pcb://142.453375,36.31)
